thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager generated: HIGH_ERROR_RATE for service=runtime-proxy region=us-east-1 — triggering page to SRE oncall. sample_rate=0.12, 5m error_pct=18%. link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-045

maria: I'm on it. Starting triage — checking recent deploys and scaling events. reassigning page to myself.

kevin: I'm available for quick help. Any customer impact yet?

maria: Initial look: increased 5xx from model-pool (gpu-1) nodes in us-east-1. Traffic still flowing, but tail latency spikes and some requests returning 503s. Top error: "kv-cache-miss leading to OOM fallback" in logs.

li: Pushed a tiny config change to kv-cache timeout yesterday, could be related. marcia? (cc @kevin)

maria: A/B deploy of runtime v3.7 was on last night, ~10% of traffic to v3.7 in us-east. Rolling back that canary in a minute if needed.

jamal: Tagging customer-facing: support-alert created. No major customers paged yet but some 5min upticks on telemetry dashboards.

maria: Mitigation plan: 1) drain v3.7 canary in us-east (no restart), 2) route a small % of traffic to us-west as a soft failover, 3) mute noisy alert rules to avoid paging storm while we stabilize.

kevin: For routing, runbook has `rtrctl set-weight runtime-proxy us-east-1 0.85` and `rtrctl set-weight runtime-proxy us-west-2 1.15` to shift ~15% to us-west. Confirming now.

maria: Executed drain for v3.7 canary. Observing error rate drop on those pods.

oncall-rotation: Note: handoff scheduled in 40m. If this continues we should do a formal escalation and handover to next oncall.

maria: Adjusted region weights per runbook. Traffic shift started; latency normalized for most requests. us-east error_pct down to 7% in 5m window.

li: Looking at logs — I see repeated cache serialization failures in one instance of the shared kv-store. Patch that node's config? Might be a hot shard.

dave: I'm spinning up a replacement kv-store pod in us-east and adding it to the ring. If this is a shard hotspot, we'll rebalance.

maria: While we mitigate, muting the noisy alert group `errors.region_high` for us-east to reduce duplicate pages. Creating a new temp composite alert `region_health_degraded` that only fires if (error_pct > 10% AND latency_95 > 800ms) for 2 consecutive windows — reduces flapping.

kevin: Good call. We should also add a short cooldown to the auto-scaler to avoid churn while traffic rebalances. Suggest `scale_cooldown=180s`.

jamal: Support update sent to customers with potential blips in us-east and note that we shifted some traffic to other regions. Kept messaging careful: no data loss, degraded latency for some users.

maria: dave reports replacement kv-store is joined and reshaping started. Errors trending down further. us-east error_pct now 3.9%.

li: After this stabilizes, we need a follow-up: 1) tune the kv-cache serialization retry back-off; 2) add observability for per-shard queue depths; 3) raise the region imbalance alert threshold to avoid noisy pages at small-scale blips.

maria: Agreed. I'll create the post-incident action items. Also want a new Grafana panel showing cross-region request ratio + per-region 95p latency, and a failover runbook entry for partial-region degradation.

kevin: For the alert tuning: propose new thresholds and rationale in PR: - `errors.region_high` -> only fire at >12% for 5m or >8% for 15m. - composite `region_health_degraded` for correlated symptoms.

maria: I'll own the PR and link to the incident timeline.

oncall-rotation: Handoff: I'm taking over in 30m; will re-check metrics at 15m intervals.

jamal: Please include a note to customers who rely on us-east low-latency endpoints that we shifted traffic — ops team to validate no routing rules broken for dedicated accounts.

maria: Confirmed: dedicated customers with fixed-region pins were unaffected. Only non-pinned traffic was shifted.

li: Postmortem checklist item: add an automated check that detects hot shards in kv-store and triggers early rebalance before user-facing errors.

maria: Creating INC-2026-045 postmortem draft and adding follow-ups: (1) alert tuning PR, (2) new Grafana dashboard panel, (3) kv-store hot-shard detection, (4) runbook update for regional soft-failover.

kevin: :thumbsup: Also recommend adding a synthetic canary that exercises kv-serialization path every 5m to catch this earlier.

maria: Thanks all. Marking incident as mitigated. Will leave the temporary alert mutes in place for 2 hours then reevaluate. Closing the immediate page.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 marked MITIGATED by maria. Followups: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-045/postmortem
